newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen names new minister of education.
newsitem.headline: Yemen names new minister of education.

text.p: Yemen on Thursday named an economics professor and former deputy minister to replace Abdu Ali al-Qubati as the country's education minister.
"A republican decree was issued today, Thursday, appointing Abdul-Majid al-Makhlafi as minister of education," the official SABA news agency said.
Both Qubati and Makhlafi are members of the Islamist Islah Party, which rules in coalition with President Ali Abdullah Saleh's General People's Congress party.
Qubati had been in dispute with his party for allegedly not following its guidelines on education.
The Islah newspaper said in a recent article that Qubati no longer represented the party.

Makhlafi taught as a professor of economics at Sanaa University until his appointment. In 1995 he resigned as deputy minister of supply and trade when the ministry was taken over by the General People's Congress.
The Islah party is led by parliamentary speaker Sheikh Abdullah Bin Hussein al-Ahmar.
The current coalition government was formed in October 1994 after the end of the Yemeni civil war.
